metas.name: SpongeBob SquarePants
metas.description: The misadventures of a talking sea sponge who works at a fast food restaurant, attends a boating school, and lives in an underwater pineapple.

metas.name: Avatar: The Last Airbender
metas.description: After a century frozen in ice, young Avatar Aang journeys with friends to master the four elements and bring balance to a world at war with the Fire Nation.

metas.name: The Legend of Korra
metas.description: Avatar Korra fights to keep Republic City safe from the evil forces of both the physical and spiritual worlds.

metas.name: The Fairly OddParents
metas.description: After being tortured and humiliated by his babysitter, a ten year old boy is put under the care of two fairy godparents, who can grant him almost any wish, which leads to dire consequences.

metas.name: Danny Phantom
metas.description: A 14-year-old receives ghost powers and uses them to save the world.

metas.name: Rugrats
metas.description: Tommy, Chuckie, Angelica, Phil and Lil and Susie find themselves in a slew of adventures - both real and imaginary. Baldly go where no baby's every gone before as the Rugrats turn the ordinary into the extraordinary every day.

metas.name: Hey Arnold!
metas.description: The everyday life of Arnold, a fourth-grader in the city of Hillwood, Washington, who lives in a multi-racial boarding house with his grandparents and a motley assortment of friends and neighbors.

metas.name: Rocko's Modern Life
metas.description: The wacky misadventures of an Australian wallaby and his friends as he finishes his transition to American life.

metas.name: Invader ZIM
metas.description: An alien named Zim from the planet Irk is sent on a secret mission to conquer Earth, not realising that his leaders were just trying to get rid of him and hoped that he would die. Once there, Zim manages to disguise himself as a h...

metas.name: The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
metas.description: A young boy, who happens to be a genius, lives in a small town with his family and friends and often gets into crazy adventures with them involving the things he invents.

metas.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
metas.description: Four ninja turtles, mutated by a mysterious alien substance, must rise up out of the sewers and defend New York City against evil forces from both the past and present.

metas.name: The Loud House
metas.description: Lincoln Loud is an eleven-year-old boy who lives with ten sisters. With the help of his right-hand man Clyde, Lincoln finds new ways to survive in such a large family every day.

metas.name: CatDog
metas.description: The life and times of a cat and a dog with a unique twist: they're connected, literally. Adding to their dilemma is Cat's annoyance with Dog, mainly caused by Dog's stupidity and Cat's up-tight personality.

metas.name: The Wild Thornberrys
metas.description: Eliza Thornberry is not your ordinary kid. It's not just because she travels the world in an RV with her parents: famous nature show hosts. Eliza also happened to be granted the magical ability to talk with and understand animals.

metas.name: Rocket Power
metas.description: Four friends and their daily lives of playing extreme sports, surfing, and getting into some crazy situations.

metas.name: The Angry Beavers
metas.description: Brothers Daggett and Norbert Beaver have left home to gain independence by living on their own. Their goal is to live a wild bachelor lifestyle but, as might be expected from young brothers, they get into some weird situations.

metas.name: Aaahh!!! Real Monsters
metas.description: The show takes us through the struggles of life as a child monster. Three monster friends are studying how to scare humans in school. Often, their attempts don't work out as planned.

metas.name: My Life as a Teenage Robot
metas.description: The escapades of a super-powered robot who happens to resemble a teenage girl that tries to balance high school and teen problems while trying to save the world from danger.

metas.name: ChalkZone
metas.description: The adventures of a boy with a magic chalk stick that enables him to enter a world of chalk drawings and alter its reality at will.

metas.name: As Told by Ginger
metas.description: The TV cartoon follows a preteen girl named Ginger Foutley, along with two friends, as they try to fit in social life as well in school and try to avoid any embarrassments.

metas.name: All Grown Up!
metas.description: Follows the adventures of an older Rugrats gang.

metas.name: The Ren & Stimpy Show
metas.description: Ren, a psychotic Chihuahua, and Stimpson J. Cat, a dimwitted Manx cat who goes by the nickname Stimpy, have a host of unusual adventures.

metas.name: The Penguins of Madagascar
metas.description: The daily adventures of penguins living in New York's Central Park Zoo.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
metas.description: The further adventures of Po the Dragon Warrior and his friends.

metas.name: Doug
metas.description: The life of a young boy as he meets friends, falls in love, maneuvers his way through grade 6 and writes all about it in his journal.

metas.name: KaBlam!
metas.description: An animated anthology show hosted by two kids who live in a comic book.

metas.name: Blue's Clues
metas.description: Blue is a puppy who puts her paw prints on three clues. Steve or Joe has to deduce the clues (with the help of off-screen children) to figure out what Blue wants to do.
